text_block_list.text:
The time for training camp is here once
again.
Unlike last year, Найс Нэйчер
seems enthusiastic.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
We have the autumn Tenno Sho ahead
of us, and
the Arima Kinen after that.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her red-hot summer of self-development
begins!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
